name: SciArena
description: SciArena is an open and collaborative platform for evaluating foundation models on scientific literature-grounded tasks. It uses community voting on model comparisons to provide a community-driven evaluation of model performance on open-ended scientific tasks requiring literature-grounded, long-form responses. It also includes SciArena-Eval, a meta-evaluation benchmark measuring the accuracy of models in judging answer quality.
reputation: SciArena is a recent but notable community-driven benchmark for scientific literature-grounded model evaluation, with growing interest because it combines human voting and meta-evaluation of model judging.
notes: Includes a meta-evaluation benchmark (SciArena-Eval) based on collected preference data to measure model accuracy in judging answer quality.
